metadata.workload_description: Mixed enterprise banking queries: authorized reads, transactional writes, tenant-scoped RLS queries, RBAC security violations, and sensitive PII queries

architectural_comparison_pgaudit.pgaudit_layer: PostgreSQL Executor Hook (C-extension writing plaintext to syslog/stderr)
architectural_comparison_pgaudit.vaultdb_layer: Zero-Trust Inline Security Middleware Proxy (AST parsing, RBAC, RLS, Masking, Dual-Storage immudb)
architectural_comparison_pgaudit.security_tradeoff_summary: While pgAudit has minimal logging latency (<1 ms) due to unindexed flat file writes, it offers zero tamper resistance against DBAs or root users, no cryptographic Merkle proofs, no dynamic PII masking, no tenant RLS, and no AST SQL injection firewall. VaultDB performs comprehensive zero-trust validation and cryptographic ledger sealing for enterprise non-repudiation.
